title: Will Status Weekly Years Since Signed Trend
dataSources: Trust documents (`trust:document`), will status logs (`will:status`), power-of-attorney records (`poa:record`), and estate review sessions (`estate:review`).
app: Trust document vault exports, will status trackers, power-of-attorney records, and estate review checklists forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=will:status years_since_signed=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(years_since_signed) as avg_duration, max(years_since_signed) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst years since signed for will status events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture years_since_signed on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average years since signed with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It records whether will status tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
